testcase.name: Scenario: Page between staged commands in a short target list: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1643:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Page between staged commands in a short target list ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And ribbon customization is open in the MCAD Software for the Part Tools target ✔ And "2D Sketches" and "3D Annotations" are staged in that order ✔ And both staged rows have Large and Text unchecked ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the target list and presses Page Down ✔ Then "3D Annotations" is highlighted ✔ And both rows remain in their original order with their display options unchecked ✔ When the user presses Page Up ✔ Then "2D Sketches" is highlighted ✔ And both staged rows and their display options remain unchanged ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes without applying the staged commands
